FULL TEXT:
Centre for Stem Cell Tissue Engineering and
Biomedical Excellence
(Pharmaceutical Extension Block – 2nd Floor)
Panjab University, Chandigarh–160014
ADVERTISEMENT NOTICE
Applications are invited for one post of Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor) in the Centre for
Stem Cell Tissue Engineering & Biomedical Excellence, Panjab University, Chandigarh to be
filled in through Walk-In Interview, purely on temporary basis, for the academic Session
January-May 2024 to teach M.Sc. course of the Centre.
Minimum qualifications for the aforementioned post are as per UGC norms.
Qualifications for the post of one (01) Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor)
Essential Qualification:
(i) M.Sc. in Stem Cell & Tissue Engineering/ Biochemistry/ Biotechnology from
an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign
University with good academic record as defined by the concerned University
with at least 55% of the marks (50% in case of SC/ST/OBC/Physically & Visually
handicapped) or an equivalent grade in a point wherever grading system is
followed at Master’s degree level.
(ii) Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the
National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR.
(iii) The candidates, who are, or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance
with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for
Award of Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009, shall be exempted from the
requirement of the minimum eligibility condition of NET for recruitment and
appointment of Assistant Professor or equivalent positions in
Universities/Colleges/Institutions.
DesirableQualification:
 Ph.D. degree in Stem Cell & Tissue Engineering/ Biochemistry/ Biotechnology
with at least two-years of research experience or teaching experience of post-graduate
classes in the field of respective subject with relevant publication/s in peer reviewed
journals.
Honorarium:
The appointment of Guest Faculty is on lecture basis with token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate has to undertake that he
/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency and
will do the same till they are teaching in the Centre for Stem Cell Tissue Engineering &
Biomedical Excellence.
Instructions for applicants:
All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant documents
for verification along with the duly filled form giving the details on 12th April 2024 at 10:30
a.m. (Reporting Time).
The applicants are required to fill the application form for Assistant Professors available at
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf
(pages 1 to 11).
Note: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
Interview will be held on 12th April 2024 at 11:00 a.m. in the Committee Room of the
Centre for Stem Cell Tissue Engineering & Biomedical Excellence, Panjab University,
Chandigarh.
(Dr. Seemha Rai)
Chairperson
